horizon.what: Results of TRAILRUNNER-ALZ 1, its main final-stage trial.
horizon.context: Finished in May 2026, results not yet announced. Would show whether a self-injected shot works like Kisunla.

horizon.what: Results of its large heart-attack prevention trial (ORION-4). If positive, it becomes a twice-a-year shot with proven heart benefit.
horizon.context: The big one for Leqvio: if the trial shows fewer heart attacks, it becomes the only twice-a-year shot proven to prevent them.

horizon.what: The FDA's decision on approval, due November 14, 2026.
horizon.context: A test of whether the FDA will approve without a clear survival benefit.

horizon.what: Lilly plans to apply for FDA approval in early 2027.
horizon.context: The step before approval; a decision would usually follow about a year later.

horizon.what: First randomized results from SUNRAY-01, in first-line lung cancer.
horizon.context: The first head-to-head test against standard treatment.

horizon.what: Results of a second heart-attack prevention trial (VICTORION-2 PREVENT).
horizon.context: A second, independent test of the same question, in people already taking a statin.

horizon.what: First results from the MARITIME final-stage trials.
horizon.context: Would show whether a monthly shot can match weekly ones.

horizon.what: Results of TRAILBLAZER-ALZ 3, which treats people with amyloid but no symptoms yet.
horizon.context: Tests whether treating before symptoms start can delay Alzheimer's.

horizon.what: TRONTIER 1 and 2 are expected to finish around June 2028.
horizon.context: The test of whether faster amyloid clearing means slower decline.

horizon.what: Results from its mid-stage trial (HEART-3), the next step toward a one-time treatment.
horizon.context: The first larger test of a one-time treatment meant to lower LDL for life. Good results would move it toward final-stage trials.
